text: Maakan ɓe an Nulaaɗo: Yeetee lam, si Alla waɗiranii on ñalorma on, duumiiɗo haa Ñalnde Darngal, ko hommbo e reweteeɗi ɗin gaanin Alla, woni ko addonoyta jemma, mo deeƴoton e mu'un, fowtoɗon battane ronkere ñalorma nden? E on yi'ataa ɗii maandeeji? Anndon reweteeɗo goo alaa, ko waɗana on ɗum fow?
